turns.speaker: D
turns.text: What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: I have had a really bad headache for the past three days.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Where do you feel the pain?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: Mostly on the right side, behind my eye and temple. It feels throbbing and pulsing.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: How severe is it?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: Around 7 or 8 out of 10. Bright light and loud noises make it worse. I had to leave work early because fluorescent lights made it intolerable.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Any nausea, vomiting, or vision changes?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: I felt nauseous yesterday, but I did not vomit. No spots, flashes, or other vision changes.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Have you taken anything?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: I took ibuprofen 400 milligrams yesterday evening. It reduced the pain to about a 5, but it returned overnight.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Have you had similar headaches before?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: Only occasional mild tension headaches, nothing this intense.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Any chronic conditions, daily medications, or medication allergies?

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: No chronic conditions. No regular daily medications. No known drug allergies.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Your blood pressure is 122 over 78, heart rate is 72, temperature is 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit, and respiratory rate is 16.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Cranial nerves 2 through 12 are intact. Your neck is supple with full range of motion. There is no tenderness over the temporal arteries or sinus areas. Neurologically, everything looks normal.

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: What do you think it is?

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: This presents classic features of an acute migraine without aura.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: I am prescribing sumatriptan 50 milligrams at the onset of a migraine attack. If it does not resolve within two hours, you can take a second dose, up to a maximum of 200 milligrams in 24 hours.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Rest in a quiet, dark room and stay well hydrated.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: If pain worsens significantly or you develop new neurological symptoms such as weakness, numbness, or vision loss, seek urgent care or emergency evaluation immediately.

turns.speaker: P
turns.text: Thank you.
